parent_variant: reme-origin-embedding3large (executor and prompt lineage; new MetaWeft memory policy)
parent_source: metaskill-appworld/baselines/reme2f37a15/benchmark/appworld/appworld_react_agent.py and prompt.py; bundled upstream 2f37a159b72a04ac1885a7db7f1a663a833e7791; inspected sibling checkout 2bd51dabc0e84c2d6aa9f9db66e630a78f58ab94 with local integration changes. Reuses sibling AppWorld loader/evaluator, experiments/code/common runner/episodes/lm_logger, and run lifecycle/runtime helpers. Each invocation preserves actual MetaWeft and sibling working-source snapshots plus hashes; the revision alone is not the executed-source record.
hypothesis: A procedural-memory pipeline combining task-conditioned adaptation and evidence-grounded semantic consolidation can improve ordered-task reuse relative to matched direct execution. V1 smoke tests establish pipeline operation, not a performance improvement.
intended_differences: Replace native ReMe retrieval formatting and success-only summary/addition/utility eviction with one adaptation pass, reflection on successes and failures, and sequential add/skip/revise/defer consolidation. Use 40 executor interactions and at most three physical transient attempts per logical provider call. Compare the complete system with metaweft-direct-v1; this is not an adaptation-only ablation or exact ReMe reproduction.
memory_structure: Flat per-stream Elasticsearch records with stable IDs, when_to_use, procedural content, supporting source-evidence references, and a 1024-dimensional text-embedding-3-large vector of when_to_use plus content. Snapshot the complete records, vectors, and mapping. No graph, multi-index representation, utility eviction, or implicit truncation.
retrieval: One task-instruction embedding and up to five vector neighbors before execution; use fewer when available and skip guidance when empty. Candidate consolidation separately retrieves up to five neighbors against the current store, including earlier confirmed writes from the same task. Preserve retrieval identities/content and failures.
adaptation: One fixed versioned prompt conditions retrieved records on the current task and returns execution guidance, including empty guidance when none applies. No iterative retrieval or adaptation. Exhausted retrieval/adaptation failure is recorded and execution continues without guidance; no extra LLM repair of invalid structured output.
execution_context: ReMe-derived AppWorld ReAct execution with qwen3.8-flash, temperature 0.9, seed 0, thinking disabled, at most 40 interactions, and one primary trial. Attach adapted guidance once to the initial task context. Base owns an explicit executor prompt initially matched to direct's separate prompt. Shared official loading, evaluation, and canonical logging remain in use. Chat/embedding attempts time out after 120/30 seconds; transient calls have at most three physical attempts with waits of 1 and 5 seconds. AppWorld environment random_seed=100 is distinct from the model seed.
evidence_update: After execution, preserve the task specification, full trace, and official scalar reward. One temperature-zero reflection pass proposes at most three candidates from success or failure, distinguishing demonstrated knowledge from inference/untested fixes. Sequential consolidation consults up to five neighbors and their preserved allowed evidence, then adds, skips, revises with supporting provenance, or defers unresolved conflicts. Complete confirmed updates before advancing. On a reflection/consolidation failure, retain confirmed prior writes and log failure plus skipped remaining work. No automatic deletion; missing evidence cannot justify an unsupported overwrite.
feedback_access: Executor receives task/API descriptions, environment observations, and adapted guidance. Adaptation sees the task and retrieved records. Reflection and consolidation may consume only task specifications, preserved execution traces, and scalar rewards, including matched memories' referenced evidence. Reference solutions, private evaluator data, and official assertion text remain evaluation-only. Evidence references resolve to preserved run artifacts.
memory_lifetime: Fresh empty memory per invocation and test split; ordered tasks within a split share completed updates. Writable stores, databases, caches, and outputs are isolated. Preserve initial, per-task, and resulting memory plus update history. No training, warm-start import, resume, or task parallelism.
failure_reporting: Memory fallbacks are explicit degraded stage outcomes; completed stream status remains separate from benchmark success and degradation. Canonical logging, provenance, initial empty-memory verification, execution infrastructure, and evaluation failures are fatal. Later unavailable snapshots are explicit evidence gaps: task snapshots degrade their task, and failed final snapshots remain in phase evidence_gaps. Unknown usage/cost is not zero.
